before.scope: Five-second aggregate and CPU0 idle samples plus live build/codec/profiler process checks. Load averages are diagnostic only: dedicated VM use is exclusive and historical own work requires no cooldown. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

validation.name: WarmVp8Decode
validation.rasterRecipe: Existing original RGBA8 RGB bytes unchanged; alpha set to255. No additional original image.
validation.cancellationBoundary: One live never-signaled token supplied to every timed public Decode; token creation/disposal excluded. Pre-cancellation/token identity checked outside timing.

nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm VP8 decode FFmpeg worker

validation.boundary: Identical resident frozen opaque VP8 keyframe input to independent owned RGBA8. Complete public managed Decode/disposal; native software webp decode/state reset, centered bilinear chroma expansion, limited BT601 conversion through RGBA16, no-dither RGBA8 reduction and real scratch/output allocation/release. One codec/conversion thread, normal SIMD. Opaque alpha255 comes from RGB conversion, with no alpha-plane merge. Contexts and packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes/converts all pixels. Padded rows exposed directly. Startup/I/O/IPC/hashing/checks/encoding excluded. One opacity projection of the existing original raster; no quality enumeration. Identical-input decode requires no matched encode quality.
